gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-looped-fs-lite: Curves that stop short of closing give IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped its approachable feel, while Literata brings a bookish, sophisticated weight. One feels like a clean modern signpost, the other a well-thumbed novel.
gen-gf-iceberg-bitter: Dependable and grounded, the slab-serif body has a very large lowercase eye and a gap you can see through in each s. Bitter gives Iceberg's drafting-pen precision a sturdy floor to stand on.
gen-gf-iceberg-inter: Inter has a tall lowercase and counters that breathe. Beneath Iceberg's marker-tip letters and large lowercase eyes, that smooth, tube-like line feels like a quiet reply to a loud voice.
gen-gf-iceberg-mulish: Expressive marker-tip letters in Iceberg sit over Mulish, a body with no thick-and-thin modulation, horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height. Its best trick is bold personality sitting over friendly, modern plainness.
gen-gf-iceberg-poppins: Bold, marker-tip letters with large lowercase eyes make Iceberg the loud one. Poppins brings loose, rope-like curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase, giving that loudness a modern, clean counterweight.
gen-gf-iceberg-roboto-slab: Pressed-twine strokes, flat and bold: Iceberg looks drawn with a marker tip, with large lowercase eyes. And Roboto Slab, a precise slab-serif with open throats, gives the middle of each line a structured weight.
gen-gf-iceberg-rubik: Iceberg draws every letter with a single constant line width, while Rubik takes the soft, clean role. Rubik's lowercase looks big beside capitals, so paragraphs should glide along.
gen-gf-idiqlat-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and classic, Idiqlat keeps its weight changes present but never dramatic, with slits where a wide mouth might sit. Idiqlat holds the gravity, while Bespoke Sans supplies sharp, refined openness.
gen-gf-im-fell-double-pica-sc-fs-bespoke: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space at curve ends. Beneath the razor-thin serifs of IM Fell Double Pica SC, extended reading would feel crisp and uncluttered rather than heavy.
gen-gf-im-fell-dw-pica-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems. Bespoke Sans gives extended reading some light against IM Fell DW Pica's huddled, tile-like glyphs.
